{{Top|leg}}
'''Interchips''' were used to transfer [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] between individuals and stores. About the size of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], interchips deducted the correct number of credits from an individuals' [[Credit chip/Legends|credit chip]] and applied it to the store's account.
